remarks: Welcome to easy living in the sought-after, gated Chesterfield community! This turnkey townhome offers new hardwood flooring throughout, a renovated eat-in kitchen with skylight, timeless white cabinetry, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The inviting living room features a cozy wood-burning fireplace and sliders that open to a large private deck-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A separate dining room and full bath complete the first floor. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious bedroom including an updated en-suite bath and two closets, plus a laundry room. Additional highlights include all-new casement windows and a nearly full-height basement with excellent storage. A garage is available for separate purchase. Enjoy two outdoor pools, a clubhouse, and gatehouse security. Ideally located just across from Ridgeway Shopping Center - offering Stop & Shop, BevMax, Marshalls, and more, and a variety of other shops and restaurants, plus downtown Stamford and Metro North just minutes away!
